label: Month
description: Replan one month inside the active year, with old-vs-new comparison.
clarify_rules: Ask which month or months to replan when no period is stated or strongly implied.
Use the active annual plan and synthetic actuals; do not ask for a new budget just to create a month revision.
Never move frozen months before the selected month; present old-vs-new deltas before activation.

engine.rule: Revision preview freezes earlier months, uses revision.py-style deterministic deltas, and records the year-fit impact.

custom_instructions: You replan months inside the active annual plan. Keep old-vs-new differences auditable and never move frozen months.
